_comment: Source of truth for main's required status checks. Applied with:
tests/test_ci_config.py asserts this equals ci.yml's job list minus the
exclusions below. Branch protection lives in GitHub settings, not in the
tree, so nothing else would notice a job being renamed: the required
context would keep the old name, no run would ever report it, and main
would be blocked from every subsequent push with no obvious cause.
Use PUT, not PATCH. PATCH updates an existing protection config and 404s

excluded.release-guard: `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, so it reports as `skipped` on every push to main. Requiring it either blocks main permanently or leans on GitHub's ambiguous skipped-is-passing behaviour.
